text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Lane four, computers. Nineteen eighty-one: simulated turbulence grows dynamos. Nineteen ninety-five: a simulated Earth's core reverses its field. Ringed pins mark papers co-signed by this project's supervisors. Nineteen ninety-seven: two simulated counter-rotating eddies make a dynamo. Two thousand five: such dynamos still work at a <|phoneme_start|>P IY1 EH1 M<|phoneme_end|> of one hundredth.
